ai.summary: A doctor in Delhi discusses diabetes risks with a retired headmaster and his son, highlighting prediabetes in South Asian communities and the importance of early intervention.

facts.claim: Rasool sahib's blood glucose was 420 mg/dL
facts.quote: The glucometer showed 420 mg/dL, two hours after his breakfast of nun chai and two kulchas.
His report arrived two days later: HbA1c 6.1%. This was in the prediabetes range, not the diabetes range.

facts.claim: South Asian populations are at higher risk for type 2 diabetes
facts.quote: People of South Asian origin are more likely to develop type 2 diabetes at a younger age and at a lower BMI than many other populations.
